quests.instruction: Which type of vehicle can travel over land and also float and drive through water?
quests.hint: Think about a vehicle that can drive right off a road and straight into a lake without stopping.
quests.explanation: An amphibious vehicle travels on land and in water. Amphibious vehicles can drive from a road right into a lake!
quests.funFact: The word amphibious comes from a word meaning able to live both on land and in water!

quests.instruction: Which long truck bends in the middle so it can turn corners more easily?
quests.hint: Think about a long truck with a hinge in the middle, letting the whole vehicle bend around tight corners.
quests.explanation: An articulated truck bends in the middle to turn. Articulated trucks can navigate corners more easily than a rigid truck!
quests.funFact: The bending hinge on an articulated truck works a bit like the joint in your own elbow!

quests.instruction: Which train has two full levels of seating stacked on top of each other?
quests.hint: Think about a train so tall it has a whole extra level of seats built right on top.
quests.explanation: A double-decker train has two levels of seats. Double-decker trains carry more passengers in the same amount of space!
quests.funFact: A double-decker train can carry many more passengers than a regular single-level train!

quests.instruction: Which airplane can fly faster than the speed of sound itself?
quests.hint: Think about an airplane so fast it can actually outrace the speed of sound.
quests.explanation: A supersonic jet flies faster than the speed of sound. Supersonic jets can cross the ocean in just a few hours!
quests.funFact: When a supersonic jet breaks the sound barrier, it can create a loud boom heard far below!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a ship's very first official trip out to sea?
quests.hint: Think about the exciting, very first trip a brand new ship ever takes out onto the ocean.
quests.explanation: A maiden voyage is a ship's first official trip. Crowds often gather to celebrate a ship's maiden voyage!
quests.funFact: A maiden voyage is often celebrated with a special ceremony before the ship even leaves the dock!

quests.instruction: Which achievement marks the fastest speed a vehicle has ever traveled on land?
quests.hint: Think about the incredible achievement of driving faster on land than any vehicle ever has before.
quests.explanation: A land speed record marks the fastest ever speed on land. Special vehicles are built just to try for a land speed record!
quests.funFact: Vehicles built to break a land speed record are specially designed just for incredible bursts of speed!

quests.instruction: Which historic moment marks the very first time an airplane ever successfully flew?
quests.hint: Think about the historic, exciting moment when an airplane left the ground and flew for the very first time ever.
quests.explanation: A first flight marks an airplane's very first successful flight. The first flight in history changed travel forever!
quests.funFact: The very first successful airplane flight in history lasted only a matter of seconds!

quests.instruction: Which word describes how far a vehicle can travel using the least amount of fuel?
quests.hint: Think about a car that can travel very far using only a small amount of gasoline.
quests.explanation: Fuel efficiency describes traveling far using little fuel. Fuel-efficient cars help save money and protect the environment!
quests.funFact: Choosing a fuel-efficient vehicle can help a family spend much less money on gasoline!

quests.instruction: Which word describes buses, trains, and subways that anyone can ride for a fare?
quests.hint: Think about all the buses, trains, and subways that any member of the public can ride by paying a fare.
quests.explanation: Public transportation includes buses, trains, and subways anyone can ride. Public transportation helps whole cities move efficiently!
quests.funFact: Using public transportation instead of individual cars can help reduce traffic in a busy city!

quests.instruction: Which word describes vehicles, like your own family's car, used only by one person or family?
quests.hint: Think about your own family's car, used only by your family instead of shared with the public.
quests.explanation: Private transportation includes vehicles used by one person or family. A family's own car is a form of private transportation!
quests.funFact: Private transportation gives a family the freedom to travel exactly when and where they choose!

quests.instruction: Which word describes goods and cargo that are shipped quickly by airplane?
quests.hint: Think about important goods being shipped extremely quickly across the world by airplane instead of by ship.
quests.explanation: Air freight is cargo shipped quickly by airplane. Air freight helps deliver important goods very quickly!
quests.funFact: Shipping goods by air freight is fast, but shipping by sea freight can carry much larger amounts!

quests.instruction: Which word describes large amounts of cargo shipped slowly across the ocean by ship?
quests.hint: Think about huge amounts of goods being shipped slowly but cheaply across the ocean by a big cargo ship.
quests.explanation: Sea freight is cargo shipped across the ocean by ship. Sea freight can carry much larger amounts than air freight!
quests.funFact: Sea freight takes longer than air freight, but a single ship can carry an enormous amount of cargo!

quests.instruction: Which word describes cargo transported over land using long freight trains?
quests.hint: Think about heavy cargo being carried across a whole country by a very long freight train.
quests.explanation: Rail freight is cargo transported by train. Rail freight can carry heavy goods efficiently over long distances!
quests.funFact: Rail freight can move huge amounts of cargo while using much less fuel than trucks would need!

quests.instruction: Which service brings packages or groceries directly to a customer's front door?
quests.hint: Think about ordering groceries or a package and having them brought directly to your very own front door.
quests.explanation: Home delivery brings packages directly to your door. Home delivery has become a very popular modern service!
quests.funFact: Home delivery has become so popular that delivery trucks are a common sight on almost every street!

quests.instruction: Which service lets a customer collect their order without ever leaving their parked car?
quests.hint: Think about ordering something online and having a worker bring it right out to your car at the curb.
quests.explanation: Curbside pickup lets customers collect orders from their car. Curbside pickup became a popular, convenient service!
quests.funFact: Curbside pickup lets a busy family grab their order quickly without even needing to park and walk inside!

quests.instruction: Which modern traffic light uses sensors to change based on how much traffic is actually there?
quests.hint: Think about a traffic light that can sense how many cars are waiting and change itself to keep traffic flowing.
quests.explanation: A smart traffic light uses sensors to adjust to traffic. Smart traffic lights help reduce waiting and traffic jams!
quests.funFact: A smart traffic light can actually learn the busiest times of day and adjust itself automatically!

quests.instruction: Which small wheeled robot delivers packages or food along the sidewalk by itself?
quests.hint: Think about a small robot rolling along the sidewalk all by itself, delivering a food order to someone's door.
quests.explanation: A delivery robot delivers packages along the sidewalk. Delivery robots are a very modern kind of technology!
quests.funFact: A delivery robot uses cameras and sensors to safely navigate sidewalks all on its own!

quests.instruction: Which futuristic aircraft could one day carry passengers short distances through city skies?
quests.hint: Think about a small, quiet aircraft that could one day fly passengers quickly over busy city traffic.
quests.explanation: A flying taxi is a futuristic aircraft for city travel. Flying taxis could one day help people avoid busy traffic!
quests.funFact: Engineers are currently testing flying taxis that could one day fly over busy city streets!

quests.instruction: Which growing idea lets everyday people travel into space just for the adventure?
quests.hint: Think about the exciting new idea of everyday people, not just astronauts, traveling into space just for fun.
quests.explanation: Space tourism lets everyday people travel to space for adventure. Space tourism is a very new and exciting idea!
quests.funFact: Space tourism is helping more people experience the incredible view of Earth from way up in space!

quests.instruction: Which type of vehicle produces no harmful gases at all while it runs?
quests.hint: Think about a vehicle, like an electric car, that produces absolutely no harmful smoke or gas while driving.
quests.explanation: A zero-emission vehicle produces no harmful gases. Zero-emission vehicles help keep our air clean!
quests.funFact: Choosing a zero-emission vehicle is one way people help take care of our planet's air!

quests.instruction: Which type of fuel is made from plants instead of oil found deep underground?
quests.hint: Think about a fuel made from corn or other plants, instead of oil pumped up from deep underground.
quests.explanation: Biofuel is fuel made from plants. Biofuel is a renewable alternative to fuel made from oil!
quests.funFact: Biofuel can be made from crops like corn, which can be grown again and again!

quests.instruction: Which type of fuel powers a vehicle using hydrogen gas, producing only water as exhaust?
quests.hint: Think about a fuel that powers a car using hydrogen gas, with clean water coming out the exhaust pipe instead of smoke.
quests.explanation: Hydrogen fuel powers vehicles using hydrogen gas. Hydrogen fuel vehicles produce only clean water as exhaust!
quests.funFact: A hydrogen fuel vehicle's only exhaust is simple water vapor, cleaner than regular gasoline exhaust!

quests.instruction: Which modern cargo ship uses giant sails to save fuel while crossing the ocean?
quests.hint: Think about a huge modern cargo ship with giant sails attached, using wind to help save fuel on its long trip.
quests.explanation: A wind-powered ship uses giant sails to save fuel. Wind-powered ships are a modern, eco-friendly shipping idea!
quests.funFact: Adding giant sails to a modern cargo ship can help it use noticeably less fuel on a long voyage!

quests.instruction: Which type of ship can travel for years without refueling, powered by nuclear energy?
quests.hint: Think about a powerful ship, like an icebreaker, that can travel for years without ever needing to stop for fuel.
quests.explanation: A nuclear-powered ship runs on nuclear energy for years. Nuclear-powered ships can travel very long distances without refueling!
quests.funFact: A nuclear-powered icebreaker can crash through thick ice for years before it ever needs to refuel!

quests.instruction: Which old, classic car is treasured and kept in excellent condition by collectors?
quests.hint: Think about a beautifully preserved old car from many decades ago, polished and cared for by a proud collector.
quests.explanation: A vintage car is an old, classic car kept in great condition. Collectors treasure and carefully maintain a vintage car!
quests.funFact: Some vintage car collectors spend years carefully restoring an old car to look brand new again!

quests.instruction: Which futuristic car is built to show off brand new ideas, not usually meant to be sold?
quests.hint: Think about a bold, futuristic car shown at a special event, built to show off brand new design ideas.
quests.explanation: A concept car shows off futuristic ideas. Concept cars are usually not built to be sold to everyday drivers!
quests.funFact: Many exciting features from a concept car eventually appear in the regular cars we drive years later!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the very first working model of a brand new vehicle design?
quests.hint: Think about the very first, carefully built test version of a brand new vehicle, before it goes on sale.
quests.explanation: A prototype is the first working model of a new design. Engineers test a prototype before building the final vehicle!
quests.funFact: A prototype is tested extensively to find and fix any problems before the real vehicle is ever built!

quests.instruction: Which special road lets engineers safely try out a brand new vehicle's speed and handling?
quests.hint: Think about a special, closed road where engineers can safely test how fast and how well a new car handles.
quests.explanation: A test track is a special road for testing vehicles. Engineers use a test track to safely try out new designs!
quests.funFact: A test track often includes sharp turns and bumpy sections to test a vehicle in every possible condition!

quests.instruction: Which testing chamber blows powerful air over a vehicle to study how smoothly it moves through air?
quests.hint: Think about a huge chamber that blows powerful wind over a car model to study how smoothly air flows around it.
quests.explanation: A wind tunnel blows air to test a vehicle's shape. Engineers use a wind tunnel to design a smoother, faster vehicle!
quests.funFact: Engineers use smoke or colorful ribbons inside a wind tunnel to actually see how air flows around a vehicle!

quests.instruction: Which lifelike test figure helps engineers study how to keep real people safer in a vehicle?
quests.hint: Think about a lifelike test figure sitting in a car seat, helping engineers learn how to make cars safer for real people.
quests.explanation: A crash test dummy helps engineers test vehicle safety. Crash test dummies help make cars safer for everyone!
quests.funFact: A crash test dummy is filled with sensors that help engineers understand exactly how to improve safety!
